result.instructions: Tools for Algolia, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which indices do we have in Algolia, and how many records is each one holding?"; "Search our products index for 'running shoes' under 100 euros, cheapest first."; "Add a synonym so that 'sneakers' also matches 'trainers' in the products index.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Algolia data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run algolia_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run algolia_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run algolia_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. algolia_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: algolia_list_indices
tools.title: List indices
tools.description: List the indices in the Algolia application with their entry counts, sizes and update times. Good first call. Algolia API: GET /1/indexes.

hitsPerPage.description: Results per page (0–1000; 0 returns counts only).

tools.name: algolia_search_index
tools.title: Search an index
tools.description: Search one index and return the matching records (hits) with highlights and facets when requested. Up to 1,000 hits; use paging for more. Algolia API: POST /1/indexes/{indexName}/query.

filters.description: Filter expression, for example "brand:Apple AND price < 500".

hitsPerPage.description: Results per page (0–1000; 0 returns counts only).

params.description: Other Algolia search parameters as an object, for example { attributesToRetrieve, facets, facetFilters }.

tools.name: algolia_multi_search
tools.title: Search several indices
tools.description: Run one or more search queries across one or more indices in one call and return one result per query, in order. A hit query has indexName and query. A facet query has indexName, type "facet", facet and query. Algolia API: POST /1/indexes/*/queries.

requests.description: The queries (hit or facet). Each has indexName, plus any search parameter at the top level.

tools.name: algolia_search_facet_values
tools.title: Search facet values
tools.description: Search the values of one facet in an index, for example brand names that start with "App". Algolia API: POST /1/indexes/{indexName}/facets/{facetName}/query.

facetQuery.description: Text to match inside the facet values.

params.description: Other Algolia search parameters as an object, for example { attributesToRetrieve, facets, facetFilters }.

tools.name: algolia_get_object
tools.title: Get a record
tools.description: Get one record by objectID, optionally with only some attributes. Algolia API: GET /1/indexes/{indexName}/{objectID}.

tools.name: algolia_get_objects
tools.title: Get several records
tools.description: Get up to 1,000 records by objectID across indices in one call. Algolia API: POST /1/indexes/*/objects.

tools.name: algolia_get_settings
tools.title: Get index settings
tools.description: Get an index's settings: searchable and facet attributes, ranking, typo tolerance and more. Algolia API: GET /1/indexes/{indexName}/settings.

tools.name: algolia_search_synonyms
tools.title: Search synonyms
tools.description: Search the synonyms of an index. Algolia API: POST /1/indexes/{indexName}/synonyms/search.

hitsPerPage.description: Results per page (0–1000; 0 returns counts only).

tools.name: algolia_get_synonym
tools.title: Get a synonym
tools.description: Get one synonym by objectID. Algolia API: GET /1/indexes/{indexName}/synonyms/{objectID}.

tools.name: algolia_search_rules
tools.title: Search rules
tools.description: Search the query rules of an index (rules that change results for matching queries or contexts). Algolia API: POST /1/indexes/{indexName}/rules/search.

anchoring.description: Match type of the rule's pattern.

context.description: Limit to rules with this context.

hitsPerPage.description: Results per page (0–1000; 0 returns counts only).

tools.name: algolia_get_rule
tools.title: Get a rule
tools.description: Get one query rule by objectID. Algolia API: GET /1/indexes/{indexName}/rules/{objectID}.

tools.name: algolia_get_task
tools.title: Check a write task
tools.description: Check whether an index write (returned as taskID) is published yet. Algolia API: GET /1/indexes/{indexName}/task/{taskID}.

taskID.description: A taskID from a write response.

tools.name: algolia_get_logs
tools.title: Get API logs
tools.description: Get the last seven days of API log entries (queries, indexing, errors), newest first. Needs a key with the logs permission. Algolia API: GET /1/logs.

tools.name: algolia_save_object
tools.title: Add a record
tools.description: Add a new record with an auto-generated objectID. Changes the index. Returns the new objectID and a taskID. Algolia API: POST /1/indexes/{indexName}.

record.description: The record as a JSON object.

tools.name: algolia_add_or_replace_object
tools.title: Add or replace a record
tools.description: Add a record with this objectID, or replace the whole existing record. Replacing drops attributes not sent. Changes the index. Algolia API: PUT /1/indexes/{indexName}/{objectID}.

record.description: The record as a JSON object.

tools.name: algolia_partial_update_object
tools.title: Update some attributes of a record
tools.description: Change only the given attributes of one record and keep the rest. Changes the index. Algolia API: POST /1/indexes/{indexName}/{objectID}/partial.

attributes.description: The attributes to set, for example { price: 399 }.

createIfNotExists.description: Create the record when it does not exist (default false).

annotations.title: Update some attributes of a record

tools.name: algolia_delete_object
tools.title: Delete a record
tools.description: Delete one record by objectID. The record is removed from search results after the returned taskID completes. Algolia API: DELETE /1/indexes/{indexName}/{objectID}.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Algolia
prompts.description: What you can do with Algolia here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: check_indices_and_their_sizes
prompts.title: Check indices and their sizes
prompts.description: List the indices with entry counts, sizes and update times, then read the settings of one index.

prompts.name: test_a_search_before_a_release
prompts.title: Test a search before a release
prompts.description: Run a search on one index, or several queries in one call, and read the facet values of one facet.

prompts.name: review_synonyms_and_query_rules
prompts.title: Review synonyms and query rules
prompts.description: Search the synonyms and query rules of an index, then read one of them by its object id.

prompts.name: update_a_record_and_confirm_it
prompts.title: Update a record and confirm it
prompts.description: Partially update the attributes of one record, then check the returned write task until it is published.

prompts.name: investigate_failed_api_calls
prompts.title: Investigate failed API calls
prompts.description: Read the API log entries of the last seven days, newest first, to find failed calls and their causes.
